funds_data.description: The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 1,500 common stocks and is designed to track the performance of small- and medium-sized U.S. companies based on the following four fundamental measures of firm size: book value, cash flow, sales and dividends.
